says: Each editor produces an owned revision or event, and one pinned validation run covers them. An Instructions source (review rules) is registered and its revision committed. A knowledge source is registered; its rate-table form profile and its tax model are checked with knowledge.member.prepare and returned as they will be committed, and a revision holding the table, the form and the model is committed. A question on that revision is asked and answered with a view, and a second revision adds the question itself as a member on the first head. A workstream and a memory source are set up; a choice resting on the knowledge revision is published, and an adoption event on that choice is applied, each committing a new memory revision. A validation request then pins the three resulting revisions by digest, one lens by name, version and digest, the question, and the knowledge revision as the package; the run the owner records is clean and lists a check that ran for every pinned target under that lens.
